title: English Conversational Foundations
description: Master essential English greetings, introductions, family terms, and daily interactions with support for automatic translation into Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, or other languages.

lessons.title: Greetings

content.example: नमस्ते, आपको देखकर अच्छा लगा!

lessons.cultural_notes: In English-speaking cultures, greetings vary by time of day (e.g., 'Good morning' before noon, 'Good evening' after 6 PM). A smile, wave, or handshake is common, especially in formal settings. Casual greetings like 'Hi' or 'What’s up?' are popular among friends.
